factoriopedia_simulation.init:
game.simulation.camera_zoom = 1    game.simulation.camera_position = {0, 0}
    game.surfaces[1].build_checkerboard{{-180, -180}, {180, 180}}

    for x = -5, 4, 1 do
      for y = -5, 4 do
        game.surfaces[1].set_chunk_generated_status({x, y}, defines.chunk_generated_status.entities)
      end
    end

    enemy = game.surfaces[1].create_entity{name = "small-demolisher", position = {0, 0}}

    step_0 = function()
      if enemy.valid then
          game.simulation.camera_position = {enemy.position.x, enemy.position.y - 0.5}
      end

      script.on_nth_tick(1, function()
          step_0()
      end)
    end

    step_0()

game.simulation.camera_zoom = 1    game.simulation.camera_position = {0, 0}
    game.surfaces[1].build_checkerboard{{-180, -180}, {180, 180}}

    for x = -5, 4, 1 do
      for y = -5, 4 do
        game.surfaces[1].set_chunk_generated_status({x, y}, defines.chunk_generated_status.entities)
      end
    end

    enemy = game.surfaces[1].create_entity{name = "medium-demolisher", position = {0, 0}}

    step_0 = function()
      if enemy.valid then
          game.simulation.camera_position = {enemy.position.x, enemy.position.y - 0.5}
      end

      script.on_nth_tick(1, function()
          step_0()
      end)
    end

    step_0()

game.simulation.camera_zoom = 1    game.simulation.camera_position = {0, 0}
    game.surfaces[1].build_checkerboard{{-180, -180}, {180, 180}}

    for x = -5, 4, 1 do
      for y = -5, 4 do
        game.surfaces[1].set_chunk_generated_status({x, y}, defines.chunk_generated_status.entities)
      end
    end

    enemy = game.surfaces[1].create_entity{name = "big-demolisher", position = {0, 0}}

    step_0 = function()
      if enemy.valid then
          game.simulation.camera_position = {enemy.position.x, enemy.position.y - 0.5}
      end

      script.on_nth_tick(1, function()
          step_0()
      end)
    end

    step_0()
